tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Repairs of Cross travel, wheel, CT Machineries of Wagnar 45/7.5 Ton Goliath Crane of Bhadra Dam

itemList.description: Dismantling, reconditioning, rewinding, including necessary spares and conversion of slip ring motors to induction motor of 18.5Kw, 760 Rpm motor for crane 75/7.5 ton Left bank Golath Crane and 45/7.5 ton Right bank Golath Crane. complete all lead and lift and as per the drawings and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Dismantling, reworking and machining of intermediate gear pinion gunmetal bush for long travel of 75/7.5 ton Left bank Golath Crane and 45/7.5 ton Right bank Golath Crane complete all lead and lift and as per the drawings and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Supply and installation, rewiring, fixing of new multifunctional timer for main hoist, auxiliary hoist for the operation of up and down, cross travel 110V Coil Volage Cutoff time 0.30sec Type:on delay analog complete all lead and lift and as per the drawings and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Supply, installation and fixing of Variable Frequency Drive (VFD) for long travel Slow Speed VFD of 37 Kw (make ABB/ Schneider) along with 
Suitable input line choke, suitable DBR (Dynamic braking resistor) power and control switch gears make-siemens/Schneider,
Outdoor IP 65 encloser for long travel of 75/7.5ton Left bank 
Golath Crane. And 45/7.5 ton Right bank Golath Crane complete all lead and lift and as per the drawings and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work

Supply and Installation Isolator switch 100 Amp with (outdoor) with canopy For long travel of 75/7.5 ton Left bank Golath Crane. And 45/7.5 ton Right bank Golath Crane. complete all lead and lift and as per the drawings and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work
